The incident exercise model combines an incident model of events, objects, and evidence with an exercise orchestration model of SOC alerts, timeline entries, learner tasks, and assessment items. The method is implemented in a Virtual SOC prototype and evaluated using a phishing-to-ransomware reference exercise. Its incident exercise model contains eight incident events, eight incident objects, six evidence items, seven alerts in five batches, 13 timeline entries including 12 learner tasks, and five representative assessment items. GLM-5.3-generated alert descriptions are inserted and a separate validator checks references, ordering, evidence links, assessment completeness, and selected fixed fields. Validation is demonstrated with reference data, resulting in true-negative outcomes for valid data and true-positive outcomes for deliberately placed inconsistencies. The resulting exercise package is executable within the Virtual SOC learner environment. Overall, the evalu

292e058b7358b31df0de864a.title_original: MammothDP: Private Boosted Decision Trees Ready for Trusted Hardware and Leakage-free Hyperparameters
292e058b7358b31df0de864a.excerpt: arXiv:2611.14317v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Data spaces like the European Health Data Space (EHDS) require the protection of sensitive data in studies during the data's processing and the study's release alike. In this work, we investigate how to implement this mandate using established trusted execution environments (TEEs) and timing side-channel hardening to protect the processing even under a compromised server, and the state-of-the-art differential privacy (DP) notion to protect the release of studies on tabular data. This combined setup could seem to complete the picture, but in fact raises unexpected security challenges that we mitigate by introducing MammothDP: a significant milestone towards a holistic machine learning system based on the recent gradient boosted decision tree learner S-BDT that is provably DP if used within a privacy filter, timing side-channel hardened, and deployed on a TEE. To achieve a strong privacy-utility tradeoff, we introduce two novel components: an early stopping criterion that adaptively selects the number of trees without any privacy overhead, and an improved rollback protection that is no longer vulnerable under timing side-channel attacks.

3f6a4da6591fe6f0a5d4db32.title_original: How Well Do SAST Tools Work Across Languages? An Empirical Study Using OCPP Implementations
3f6a4da6591fe6f0a5d4db32.excerpt: arXiv:2611.14362v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As electric vehicle (EV) adoption accelerates globally, securing electric vehicle charging station (EVCS) software becomes increasingly critical. The Open Charge Point Protocol (OCPP), widely adopted for EVCS management, places significant responsibility on developers to securely implement specifications that are subject to multiple interpretations. The variety of OCPP implementations across different programming languages provides a unique opportunity to evaluate security tooling in a real-world, multi-language context where implementation variability may introduce vulnerabilities. This study provides the first empirical evaluation of Static Application Security Testing (SAST) tool performance across multiple programming languages using OCPP implementations as a real-world test corpus. We applied both comprehensive multi-language tools (SonarQube and Semgrep) and language-specific analyzers to twelve OCPP 1.6 implementations--each written in a distinct programming language--to examine how detection patterns vary across language ecosystems. Total issues ranged from just two in Rust to 1,689 in Java. Mature programming languages like Java yielded substantially more findings than newer languages like Rust, likely because established languages have more developed SAST tool ecosystems rather than inherently worse code quality. These results suggest that developers should consider available SAST tooling when selecting implementation

3f6a4da6591fe6f0a5d4db32.summary_ko: 본 연구는 다양한 프로그래밍 언어로 작성된 전기차 충전 프로토콜(OCPP) 구현체를 대상으로 정적 애플리케이션 보안 테스트(SAST) 도구의 성능을 실증적으로 비교했다. 분석 결과, 언어별 생태계 성숙도에 따라 보안 탐지 결과가 크게 달라짐을 확인했으며 시스템 설계 시 보안 도구 가용성을 고려해야 함을 제안했다.

69757fa776cf5ebd569ac153.title_original: How wide must an eavesdropper be? Leakage of a toric-code logical bit to a strip and the Nishimori point
69757fa776cf5ebd569ac153.excerpt: arXiv:2611.13174v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computers hand pieces of each logical qubit to separate decoder modules and shared readout lines. How much does a piece reveal? We prove that for any region and any Pauli noise, including correlated noise, an observer's optimal advantage in learning a logical bit is exactly 1 - 2 P_fail, where P_fail is the failure probability of maximum-likelihood decoding confined to that region. Two lessons follow. Geometry, not noise, provides the protection: a region that misses a single column of the code learns exactly nothing at any noise level, while a region that spans the code is protected by noise only at impractical distances (d > 350 for one row at a 10^-3 flip rate). And width is a poor guide to risk: under i.i.d. noise a two-row strip learns exactly as little as one row, yet below threshold an eavesdropper needs a width growing only as ln d. Through the identity, the strip's operational threshold is the Nishimori point of the random-bond Ising model, and a Walsh-Hadamard transfer matrix up to width 16 locates it to within a few thousandths. On two IBM Heron processors (d = 3, 5), an emulated strip adversary shows the predicted jump at width three, and non-uniform qubit errors let a trained attacker profit from the second row that uniform noise makes useless. We turn these results into design rules for partitioned decoding and multiplexed readout. Code and data are included.

c46e64026f2669d8b9f7efed.title_original: Latent Barrier Steering: Hierarchical Safety for Generative Planning
c46e64026f2669d8b9f7efed.excerpt: arXiv:2611.13227v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce Latent Barrier Steering (LBS), a hierarchical semantic-to-path framework for safe flow-matching-based generative planning. Existing control-barrier-function (CBF) safety filters for diffusion and flow-matching planners act locally on generated samples, either during sampling or after prediction. Such repair is effective for small violations, but can struggle when a new constraint blocks the whole selected behavior mode rather than merely perturbing it locally. LBS decouples behavior selection from path certification through two coordinated interventions: it first steers the generator's behavior latent toward rollouts with larger safety margin, then decodes the steered latent and applies a path-space CBF quadratic program (QP) only for residual violations. We show that latent steering increases the margin available to the path-space corrector, yielding finite-time recovery guarantees and reduced correction burden. Experiments across navigation and robot end-effector planning tasks show that LBS preserves safety while improving goal reaching and reducing correction burden compared with path-level safety filters.

24e32097e42eeca5f1aa0a6d.title_original: Pulse or Provenance? What rPPG-Based Deepfake Detectors Learn
24e32097e42eeca5f1aa0a6d.excerpt: arXiv:2611.13992v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) has been proposed as a physiological cue for deepfake detection, based on the premise that synthesized faces lack a genuine cardiac signal. Removing high-frequency content makes most synthesized videos appear real, adding it makes real videos appear fake, and injecting a synthetic pulse has little effect. In controlled self-reenactment experiments with two generators, animating a face from a single frame introduces the same high-frequency signal, whereas reconstructing each frame from its own source does not. 90514be954f498505a3d340f.title_original: Secure Information Flow in Quantum Programs
90514be954f498505a3d340f.excerpt: arXiv:2611.14147v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Information-flow security aims to prevent the leakage of confidential information through program execution. This problem becomes fundamentally subtler for quantum programs, because their states may involve superposition and entanglement, and their executions may involve intricate interactions between classical and quantum variables. This paper develops semantic foundations and verification methods for secure information flow in quantum programs. We formulate two notions of information-flow security. The first is a noninterference-based definition that naturally generalizes its classical counterpart. The second is a simulation-based definition that explicitly models an attacker, providing a clear operational interpretation of security. We prove that these two notions are equivalent. To verify the information-flow security of quantum programs, we develop a proof framework based on quantum Hoare logic. A key challenge is that the standard self-composition technique, which expresses information-flow security in Hoare logic by composing a program with a renamed copy of itself, fails in the quantum setting due to an obstruction analogous to the no-cloning theorem. To overcome this challenge, we introduce self-conjugation, a novel technique that leverages the deferred measurement principle and properties of unitary operations. We demonstrate our framework on examples drawn from the quantum one-time pad, quantum error correction, and

fcde99dde69bb1b800e2bf5d.title_original: Location Matters: Sparse Latent-Variance Attacks for Face Privacy against Diffusion Personalization
fcde99dde69bb1b800e2bf5d.excerpt: arXiv:2611.14254v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Text-to-image diffusion models can learn and reproduce an individual's identity from only a few reference photos, creating risks of unauthorized and misleading content generation. Proactive defenses address this risk by adding adversarial perturbations to facial images before release, thereby disrupting identity acquisition during downstream personalization. However, existing methods typically rely on dense $L_\infty$-bounded perturbations, whose accumulated distortions can become visible around facial structures. Recent methods improve protected-image quality, but often at the cost of reduced protection effectiveness. In this paper, we propose Sparse Encoder Attack on Latent Variance (SEAL), a sparse adversarial protection framework that modifies only 5% of the spatial locations in a facial image. SEAL combines a differentiable top-k masking scheme that jointly optimizes perturbation locations and values with a variance-oriented objective over the frozen VAE encoder's latent distribution to disrupt identity-consistent representations. A saliency-guided dispersion penalty further discourages perturbation concentration in perceptually salient facial regions. Experiments on CelebA-HQ and VGGFace2 show that SEAL achieves the best protected-image quality among the compared methods, exceeding 41 dB PSNR with 0.97 SSIM and at most 0.07 LPIPS, while reducing identity similarity to at most 0.15 after diffusion personalization. These r

2f5c58f4fe255cfe030601dd.title_original: SnapAudit: Active Auditing of Differentially Private In-Context Learning via Snapshot-Based Simulation
2f5c58f4fe255cfe030601dd.excerpt: arXiv:2511.13502v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) enables LLMs to adapt to tasks using demonstrations that may contain sensitive data. Differentially private (DP) ICL mechanisms mitigate this risk by adding noise during aggregation. However, verifying their claimed privacy bounds through repeated end-to-end membership-inference attacks is costly and yields unstable estimates. We propose SnapAudit, an active auditing framework that decomposes a DP-ICL pipeline into a deterministic clean-inference stage and a stochastic DP-noise stage, and audits the full pipeline by combining a small snapshot of the former with bootstrap simulation of the latter. Because clean LLM outputs are near-deterministic at low temperature, tens of thousands of clean LLM calls suffice to approximate the snapshot distribution; SnapAudit then bootstraps hundreds of thousands of noisy trials at negligible additional cost, controlling finite-sample uncertainty via an empirical Bernstein correction. For embedding-based mechanisms, a multi-sweep search constructs maximally separable audit signals. Compared with passive auditing, SnapAudit yields tighter, more stable privacy estimates that closely match theoretical guarantees. Across privacy budgets, SnapAudit reuses snapshots across noise configurations, whereas passive auditing requires fresh end-to-end trials. Across four DP-ICL pipelines and five privacy budgets, this reduces total wall-clock auditing time by $4.3$--$5.5\times$.

ca6bdaeb103636b0e1eade01.title_original: MIRAGE: Misleading Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Black-box and Query-agnostic Poisoning Attacks
ca6bdaeb103636b0e1eade01.excerpt: arXiv:2512.08289v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems enhance LLMs with external knowledge but introduce a critical attack surface: corpus poisoning. While recent studies have demonstrated the potential of such attacks, they typically rely on impractical assumptions, such as white-box access or known user queries, thereby underestimating the difficulty of real-world exploitation. In this paper, we bridge this gap by proposing MIRAGE, a novel multi-stage poisoning pipeline designed for strict black-box and query-agnostic environments. Operating on surrogate model feedback, MIRAGE functions as an automated optimization framework that integrates three key mechanisms: it utilizes persona-driven query synthesis to approximate latent user search distributions, employs semantic anchoring to imperceptibly embed these intents for high retrieval visibility, and leverages an adversarial variant of Test-Time Preference Optimization (TPO) to maximize persuasion. To rigorously evaluate this threat, we construct a new benchmark derived from three long-form, domain-specific datasets. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MIRAGE significantly outperforms existing baselines in both attack efficacy and stealthiness, exhibiting remarkable transferability across diverse retriever-LLM configurations and highlighting the urgent need for robust defense strategies.

eb10c9bcd80d99d3930416a2.title_original: Rotated Robustness: A Training-Free Defense against Bit-Flip Attacks on Large Language Models
eb10c9bcd80d99d3930416a2.excerpt: arXiv:2603.16382v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Bit-flip corruption of quantized weights poses a serious reliability threat to Large Language Models (LLMs), as even a small number of weight faults can trigger catastrophic model degradation. Across eight evaluated LLMs, RoR matches or exceeds all compared methods in the number of cumulative PBS flips sustained before PPL exceeds 100 within the 100-flip evaluation horizon. Under BER-based random bit-flip injection, no RoR failures are observed in the evaluated 1,000-trial experiments for the tested models. Under defense-aware SPoF reconstruction, RoR increases the cost of reproducing specified one-bit catastrophic failures to thousands of deployed INT8 bit changes. RoR also preserves downstream-task utility under PBS perturbations. On NVIDIA H200 at batch size 8, RoR incurs 0.097\%--0.584\% persistent storage overhead, 5.2\%--14.1\% Prefill overhead, and 0.5\%--9.8\% Decode overhead across four representative models. These results show that sensitivity-aware hierarch

c76f4968c1f9ec1a14ebabc5.title_original: Analyzing Linear Layers in Related-Differential Cryptanalysis
c76f4968c1f9ec1a14ebabc5.excerpt: arXiv:2605.27535v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In AES-like ciphers, diffusion layers are commonly instantiated using MDS matrices, since their optimal branch number yields strong diffusion guarantees and underpins classical resistance arguments against differential and linear cryptanalysis. However, Daemen and Rijmen (2009) showed that linear layers may still exhibit related-differential structure beyond what the MDS criterion captures, and Bardeh and Rijmen (2022) demonstrated that this phenomenon can be exploited in attacks on reduced-round AES. In this work, we systematically investigate the conditions under which linear layers avoid or exhibit these differentials, identifying matrix classes for which such structure is unavoidable. We first prove that every non-MDS matrix admits a nontrivial pair of related differentials, showing that the MDS property is necessary for avoiding them. We then establish that every odd-order symmetric MDS matrix admits related differentials, which rules out broad families of Cauchy-based constructions. We also substantially strengthen the circulant case by proving that related differentials are unavoidable for every circulant matrix of order $n$ with $n \not\equiv \pm 2 \pmod{12}$. Finally, we revisit the characterization of $3 \times 3$ MDS matrices over $\mathbb{F}_{2^m}$ for the absence of related differentials, and derive an explicit necessary and sufficient criterion in terms of $15$ polynomial constraints.

1396776d5f785afb79826235.title_original: NICE: A Framework for Declarative and Machine-Checkable Vulnerability Reproduction
1396776d5f785afb79826235.excerpt: arXiv:2606.00625v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Reproducing software vulnerabilities is fundamental to security researchers, open-source maintainers, and educators. Yet, vulnerabilities are often hard to reproduce, and even when they can be reproduced once, recreating a software environment where the vulnerability can be exploited becomes harder and harder over time. We present NICE, the NIx CvE reproduction framework, which uses declarative recipes to build and automatically validate vulnerable environments. In NICE, a reproduced CVE comprises one or more NixOS virtual machine configurations, a scripted exploitation scenario, and machine-checkable assertions that provide factual evidence of exploitation. This design facilitates sharing, validation, review, and long-term reproducibility. Building on NICE, we construct a public archive of 56 reproduced vulnerabilities spanning multiple CWE categories, attack vectors, and target types (user-space, system software, kernel, and graphical applications), combining manually authored recipes with recipes produced by an LLM-based automated pipeline and merged after human review. We evaluate the feasibility of the automated pipeline on 110 real-world CVEs, achieving fully automated reproduction in 54.5% of the cases, at an average cost of $0.73 per CVE. The evaluation demonstrates that NICE provides a practical target for LLM-assisted recipe generation, while also identifying where human refinement or additional automation remains

1396776d5f785afb79826235.summary_ko: 연구진은 NixOS 가상머신 설정과 공격 시나리오, 기계 검증 가능한 점검 항목으로 취약한 환경을 재현하는 NICE 프레임워크를 제안했다. 논문은 여러 유형의 취약점 56건을 담은 공개 아카이브를 구축했으며, 실제 CVE 110건을 대상으로 한 자동화 평가에서 54.5%를 완전 자동 재현했다고 보고했다.

1637e99bbcb059389ebf7837.title_original: TGCM: Topic-Guided Consistency Modeling for One-Step Disentanglement of Interleaved APT Technique Sequences
1637e99bbcb059389ebf7837.excerpt: arXiv:2606.18651v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Multiple Advanced Persistent Threat (APT) campaigns may execute concurrently, producing audit logs whose events are interleaved without explicit campaign boundaries. We formulate this setting as Unknown-K Interleaved Sequence Demixing (UKISD): recovering coherent campaign episodes when the number of concurrent campaigns is unknown. Each episode is represented as a sequence of MITRE ATT&CK technique occurrences, and demixing is cast as occurrence-level assignment with sequence reconstruction. Existing methods often assume single-campaign observations or rely on local heuristics, limiting robustness to severe interleaving, repeated techniques, abstraction noise, and unknown mixture cardinality. We propose Topic-Guided Consistency Modeling (TGCM), a consistency-inspired one-step framework for UKISD. TGCM maps an interleaved technique sequence to campaign episodes, jointly performing occurrence assignment and sequence reconstruction in one forward pass. It combines topic guidance from ATT&CK narratives with an embedding-space self-consistency objective to improve semantic coherence and retain efficient inference. We evaluate TGCM on synthetic mixtures, mixed benchmarks, DARPA engagement traces, and CAPTure, an end-to-end benchmark containing 200 scenarios, 855 million audit events, and 25 ATT&CK-aligned attack profiles in single-host and multi-host settings. TGCM improves occurrence-level assignment under heavy interleaving, rep

c2ee17344c0b418e329fa187.title_original: Policy-Controlled Offline-Verifiable Accountability for Cross-Organization Agent Messaging: A Preserved Evidence-Bundle Approach
c2ee17344c0b418e329fa187.excerpt: arXiv:2608.28542v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Cross-organization agent workflows require preserved evidence that remains independently verifiable during later audit or dispute review. Such workflows may involve multiple organizations, delegated actions, policy-relevant events, and disputed accountability claims. This is difficult when live systems are unavailable, controlled by one party, or not trusted by all participants. Existing mechanisms provide useful pieces, including authenticated logging, delegation semantics, signed checkpoints, and consistency checks. What remains missing is a verifier-centered event-level bundle for checking evidence sufficiency offline under an explicit policy. We propose a preserved evidence-bundle model and a policy-controlled offline verifier for agent-to-agent workflow events. Each bundle preserves policy-required evidence, including sender authentication, authenticated log commitment, witness-backed checkpoint evidence, append-only continuity, delegation-aware authorization evidence, and, when issued and required by policy, explicit receiver-signed receipt evidence. The verifier accepts a bundle only when all mandatory and policy-required checks succeed, giving a later dispute reviewer an offline basis for assessing evidence sufficiency. It does not infer delivery or receipt from transport behavior or log inclusion alone. In a prototype evaluation, the event-type study used 300 synthetic four-event healthcare workflow cases and 1200 v

c0bec271bd217bd97c9d9432.title_original: Integrated Identity Protection for Semantic Communications in Embodied IoT Systems
c0bec271bd217bd97c9d9432.excerpt: arXiv:2611.06788v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Embodied Internet of Things (IoT) systems are promoting the adoption of task-oriented semantic communication (SemCom), in which the trustworthy task decisions increasingly require both semantic reliability and source legitimacy. However, existing trustworthy SemCom designs mainly focus on semantic content recovery and protection, with limited attention to source identity protection. Motivated by this limitation, this paper establishes a new information exploitation perspective for integrated SemCom-identity protection that leverages task-level error tolerance to coordinate semantic information and source identity information carried by the same waveform. We first examine these two information resources and then analyze their integration feasibility at the observation, processing, and decision levels. To exploit these resources for different identity protection objectives, we further develop a dual-branch identity protection mechanism with two operating modes. In the authentication mode, semantic recovery and physical-layer source verification are performed in parallel using the same received observation. In the concealment mode, identity exposure is suppressed while semantic reconstruction quality is maintained to support anonymous transmission. Finally, two representative case studies on active source impersonation and passive identity inference are presented to evaluate the proposed framework.

aac1e64a1de02f9fb08d2398.title_original: Nash Incentive-compatible Online Mechanism Learning via Weakly Differentially Private Online Learning
aac1e64a1de02f9fb08d2398.excerpt: arXiv:2407.04898v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study a multi-round mechanism design problem, where we interact with a set of agents over a sequence of rounds. We wish to design an incentive-compatible (IC) online learning scheme to maximize an application-specific objective within a given class of mechanisms, without prior knowledge of the agents' type distributions. Even if each mechanism in this class is IC in a single round, if an algorithm naively chooses from this class on each round, the entire learning process may not be IC against non-myopic buyers who appear over multiple rounds. On each round, our method randomly chooses between the recommendation of a weakly differentially private online learning algorithm (e.g., Hedge), and a commitment mechanism which penalizes non-truthful behavior. Our method is IC and achieves $O(T^{\frac{1+h}{2}})$ regret for the application-specific objective in an adversarial setting, where $h$ quantifies the long-sightedness of the agents. When compared to prior work, our approach is conceptually simpler,it applies to general mechanism design problems (beyond auctions), and its regret scales gracefully with the size of the mechanism class.

5f69713245ab9cb5c61337cb.title_original: Differential Privacy for Euclidean Jordan Algebra with Applications to Private Symmetric Cone Programming
5f69713245ab9cb5c61337cb.excerpt: arXiv:2509.16915v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In this paper, we study differentially private mechanisms for functions whose outputs lie in a Euclidean Jordan algebra. Euclidean Jordan algebras capture many important mathematical structures and form the foundation of linear programming, second-order cone programming, and semidefinite programming. Our main contribution is a generic Gaussian mechanism for such functions, with sensitivity measured in $\ell_2$, $\ell_1$, and $\ell_\infty$ norms. Notably, this framework includes the important case where the function outputs are symmetric matrices, and sensitivity is measured in the Frobenius, nuclear, or spectral norm. We further derive private algorithms for solving symmetric cone programs under various settings, using a combination of the multiplicative weights update method and our generic Gaussian mechanism. As an application, we present differentially private algorithms for semidefinite programming, resolving a major open question posed by [Hsu, Roth, Roughgarden, and Ullman, ICALP 2014].

ac19d0126cb7c7382435a65f.title_original: Do Reasoning LLMs Refuse What They Infer in Long Contexts?
ac19d0126cb7c7382435a65f.excerpt: arXiv:2602.08874v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Long-context LLMs can infer objectives that are not explicitly stated. This capability is useful for reasoning over documents, code, and tool traces, but it also introduces a safety risk. Harmful intent can be distributed across a context and become apparent only after the model combines the relevant information. Existing safety evaluations largely focus on explicitly stated harmful requests and therefore do not fully capture this failure mode. We introduce compositional reasoning attacks, a long-context attack setting in which harmful requests are decomposed into semantically incomplete fragments and embedded in long contexts. The final query is neutral, and the model must retrieve and combine the fragments to infer the implied harmful objective. Empirically, we show that models generally refuse harmful requests when they are explicitly stated. However, refusal rates drop when the same objectives must be reconstructed from fragments, and these failures often become more pronounced in longer contexts. Our analyses suggest that this gap cannot be explained by retrieval difficulties alone. Models can often reconstruct the harmful objective but do not reliably refuse it. Increasing inference-time reasoning effort improves refusal, but at a higher computational cost, with unsafe responses still occurring. Our results reveal a long-context safety gap: Models are better at refusing harmful requests they see than harmful obje

341631dde607424b34c49c9d.title_original: Auditing Cross-Lingual Fairness in Language Model Watermarking
341631dde607424b34c49c9d.excerpt: arXiv:2608.20047v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Watermarking schemes for large language model output are evaluated almost exclusively on English text using each scheme's detection threshold and a narrow set of quality measurements. Multilingual deployment exposes evaluation-design choices that are inconsequential on English but determine conclusions cross-lingually. We propose an evaluation framework with four components: detection thresholds calibrated empirically per deployment context, a threshold-independent companion measurement that distinguishes calibration failures from detection failures, three disjoint quality measurement paradigms (distributional, paired-semantic, and reference-perplexity), and a generalized-entropy decomposition of cross-language disparity over a typological family partition. Applied to six watermarking schemes, three open-weight generators, eleven languages spanning four scripts and eight typological families, and both base and instruction-tuned regimes, the framework reveals failure modes that single-language, single-paradigm evaluation cannot surface. Against a shape-matched null, detection disparity is predominantly between-family on the typological partition, indicating that detection gaps are structural to language properties rather than idiosyncratic to particular languages; quality disparity is large but not reliably family-structured.

f4cc47e870df1e414f0a6d06.title_original: SVP Is NP-Hard for Some Rank-2 Cyclotomic Modules
f4cc47e870df1e414f0a6d06.excerpt: arXiv:2609.01469v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Let $q$ be an odd prime. Let $\zeta_q$ be a primitive $q$th root of unity, and put $K=\mathbb{Q}(\zeta_q)$, with ring of integers $\mathcal{O}_K=\mathbb{Z}[\zeta_q]$. As $q$ ranges over odd primes, we prove that the decision version of the Shortest Vector Problem ($\mathsf{SVP}$) in the canonical $\ell_2$-norm is $\mathsf{NP}$-complete on full-rank free submodules of $\mathcal{O}_K^2$ by giving a deterministic polynomial-time many-one reduction from Exact Cover by 3-Sets (X3C). The module rank is fixed at two. The main obstacle is closure under the action of $\mathcal{O}_K$. A module containing a nonzero vector also contains every scalar multiple of that vector by a nonzero element of $\mathcal{O}_K$, and some of these multiples may be shorter. Three ideas overcome this obstacle. First, we map the Bennett--Peikert Reed--Solomon lattice to a principal cyclotomic ideal and use Wan's point-count estimates to prove that a coset of this ideal contains many binary coefficient representatives. Second, we construct a checker whose canonical squared norm encodes the X3C equations, with a controlled nonnegative error term. Third, the checker and a second module coordinate combine with a separation bound for ideal cosets to rule out short vectors in NO instances. 41f8ef89a9ff3f6c914e972c.excerpt: The cybercrime group Qilin has emerged as the world’s most active ransomware affiliate program, claiming at least 365 victim organizations in the past three months alone. But even top Russian hackers make operational security mistakes, and the administrator of Qilin has made a few key missteps over the last decade that all point to a 36-year-old man living in St. Petersburg, Russia. Operating since September 2022, the Russia-based ransomware group Qilin is the currently the most industrious ransomware-as-a-service gang, according to a report (PDF) this month by the cybersecurity firm NCC Group (KrebsOnSecurity profiled the administrator of the second most active ransomware group — The Gentlemen — in June). The Qilin ransomware administrator “Haise” advertising his affiliate program on the cybercrime forum RAMP. Image: Ke-la.com. Qilin attracts affiliates to hack into companies and deploy ransomware by offering them at least 80 percent of any extortion amount paid by victims. Its members practice the “double extortion” model, stealing sensitive data before encrypting systems and threatening to publish the files online. Unlike most ransomware partnerships based out of Russia, Qilin is happy to team with English-speaking affiliates, and its leader has shared on Telegram that they’ve worked with ransomware groups like Scattered Spider and RansomHub . 00cd69db55b1ccfa88c12b84.summary_ko: 한컴의 3분기 AI 매출은 148억원으로 별도 기준 전체 매출의 30.7%를 차지했고, AI를 포함한 신사업 매출은 309억원을 기록했다. 회사는 에이전틱 OS의 국내·유럽 상용화와 미국용 AI 워크포스 플랫폼 노마디안 출시를 추진하며, 계열사 지분 정리로 확보한 재원을 글로벌 사업에 투입할 계획이다.
00cd69db55b1ccfa88c12b84.background_ko: 한컴은 기존 고객 20만 곳 이상의 AI 결합 제품 전환과 공공·산업 분야 AX 사례 증가가 AI 매출 확대에 영향을 줬다고 밝혔다.

8aa076e87abc2b15b6da3176.title_original: 영국 AI 칩 스타트업 프랙타일, 9.3조 가치로 1조 투자 유치
8aa076e87abc2b15b6da3176.excerpt: 영국 AI 반도체 스타트업 프랙타일(Fractile)이 7억2000만달러(약 1조원)의 투자를 유치하며 기업가치를 70억달러(약 9조3000원)로 끌어올렸다. 아직 상용 제품도 출시하지 않았지만, 영국에서 기업가치가 가장 높은 기술 스타트업 중 하나로 올라섰다.프랙타일은 11일(현지시간) 시리즈 C 투자 라운드에서 7억2000만달러를 유치했다고 밝혔다. 지난 5월 11억달러로 평가받은 지 6개월 만에 기업가치가 6배 이상 상승했다.2022년 설립된 프랙타일은 런던과 브리스톨을 기반으로 AI 추론에 특화된 반도체를 개발하고 있다. 챗
8aa076e87abc2b15b6da3176.title_ko: 영국 AI 칩 스타트업 프랙타일, 7억2000만달러 투자 유치
8aa076e87abc2b15b6da3176.summary_ko: AI 추론용 반도체를 개발하는 영국 스타트업 프랙타일이 7억2000만달러를 유치해 기업가치 70억달러를 인정받았다. 자체 D램을 연산 칩 위에 쌓아 데이터 이동 병목을 줄이는 기술을 개발 중이며, 추론 속도를 최대 10배 높인다는 회사 측 주장은 아직 상용 제품으로 검증되지 않았다. 첫 상용 제품은 2027년 출시할 계획이다.
8aa076e87abc2b15b6da3176.background_ko: 창업자는 연산 성능에 비해 메모리 대역폭의 발전이 더뎌 데이터 이동이 병목이 된다고 보고, 연산 칩에 자체 D램을 쌓는 구조를 개발한다고 설명했다.

35239f869c8b05eea09c1344.title_original: 미니맥스, 4K 이미지 약 10초에 생성하는 'H3-이미지' 공개…가중치도 배포
35239f869c8b05eea09c1344.excerpt: 중국 AI 기업 미니맥스(MiniMax)가 4K 이미지를 약 10초 만에 생성하는 오픈웨이트 모델 'H3-이미지(H3-Image)'를 출시했다. 하나의 모델로 이미지 생성과 편집을 처리하고 최대 16장의 참조 이미지를 활용할 수 있는 것이 특징이다.미니맥스는 11일 공식 발표를 통해 H3-이미지를 공개하고, 모델 가중치와 관련 코드를 허깅페이스와 깃허브에 배포했다고 밝혔다. 미니맥스 API와 AI 개발 도구 '미니맥스 코드(MiniMax Code)', 영상·이미지 생성 서비스 '하이뤄 AI(Hailuo AI)'에서도 이용할 수 있다
35239f869c8b05eea09c1344.title_ko: 미니맥스, 4K 이미지 생성 모델 H3-이미지 공개…가중치 배포
35239f869c8b05eea09c1344.summary_ko: 미니맥스는 4K 이미지를 고속 모드에서 약 10초에 생성하고, 최대 16장의 참조 이미지를 활용해 편집할 수 있는 오픈웨이트 모델 H3-이미지를 공개했다. 가중치와 코드를 배포했지만 한국 등 일부 지역은 기본 커뮤니티 라이선스 대상에서 제외돼 직접 사용·배포에 별도 허가가 필요하다.
35239f869c8b05eea09c1344.background_ko: H3-이미지는 앞서 공개된 멀티모달 생성 모델 H3를 바탕으로 데이터 구성과 강화학습 등 후속학습을 개선하고 샘플링 단계를 6회로 줄여 개발됐다.

367bdaa449688f1fa0b1906f.title_original: 이스라엘 사이버부대 출신 설립 레이븐, AI 보안 앞세워 한국 시장 출사표

367bdaa449688f1fa0b1906f.title_ko: AI 기반 런타임 보안 기업 레이븐, 한국 시장 진출
367bdaa449688f1fa0b1906f.summary_ko: 런타임 애플리케이션 보안 기업 레이븐이 AI 기반 취약점 악용 대응 솔루션을 앞세워 한국 시장에 진출했다. 실행 중인 애플리케이션의 비정상 동작을 감시해 공개 취약점이나 알려진 공격 시그니처에 의존하지 않고 차단한다고 회사는 설명했으며, 금융 등 규제가 엄격한 산업을 우선 공략한다.
367bdaa449688f1fa0b1906f.background_ko: 레이븐은 CVE 공개 이후 대응하는 방식에만 의존할 수 없다는 판단 아래, 알려진 취약점이나 공격 시그니처 없이도 악용 행위를 차단하는 기술을 내세웠다.

b123a8e0f9d9d083558df5d7.title_original: 국내 연구진, 폐태양광 패널로 실리카 합성…배터리 음극 시험서 용량 20% 높여

5be350c7f5d8e17683b9cf8f.title_original: NSHC 윤선희 이사, ‘2026 국방혁신 AI유무인복합체계 발전 세미나’서 ‘공공·국방 AI 보안 전략’ 발표

5be350c7f5d8e17683b9cf8f.title_ko: NSHC, 공공·국방 AI 도입 위한 보안 전략 제안
5be350c7f5d8e17683b9cf8f.summary_ko: NSHC 윤선희 이사는 공공·국방 분야의 AI 도입 시 프롬프트를 점검하고 에이전트가 접근할 데이터와 수행 작업을 제한하는 보안 계층을 제안했다. 외부 노출 자산과 섀도 AI 관리, 배포 전후 AI 레드팀 검증, 실전형 훈련과 폐쇄망 배치도 대응 방안으로 제시했다.
5be350c7f5d8e17683b9cf8f.background_ko: 세미나는 NSHC와 대전대가 AI 유무인복합체계 및 사이버보안 전문인재 양성을 위해 체결한 산학협력 업무협약의 일환으로 마련됐다.

b455aba7903dd729ff449c63.title_original: 레드햇, AI 에이전트 통제·지원 강화한 ‘레드햇 개발자 허브 2.1’ 공개

b455aba7903dd729ff449c63.title_ko: 레드햇, AI 에이전트 통제·지원을 강화한 개발자 허브 2.1 공개
b455aba7903dd729ff449c63.summary_ko: 레드햇이 Backstage 기반 개발자 포털의 2.1 버전을 공개했다. 포털은 AI 에이전트가 내부 카탈로그·문서·운영 정보와 사전 정의된 골든 패스를 활용하게 하고, 플랫폼 팀이 작업을 통제·추적하도록 지원한다. MCP 연동, 지능형 어시스턴트, AI 자산의 카탈로그 등록 기능과 10개월 릴리스 지원도 포함됐다.
b455aba7903dd729ff449c63.background_ko: AI 코딩 에이전트는 기업의 아키텍처와 개발 표준을 충분히 파악하지 못해 재작업이 생길 수 있어, 이를 줄이는 데 초점을 뒀다.

435d788d05e251fa856bfd73.excerpt: 생성형 AI 제작 이미지 최근 Pi Network(파이 네트워크) 암호화폐 보상을 미끼로 한 스미싱이 한국 사용자를 대상으로 유포되고 있습니다. 전체 공격 흐름은 다음과 같습니다. 1. 스미싱 유포 : 카카오톡 알림톡으로 "Pi 보상" 피싱 링크 전달 2. 웹 피싱 3단계 : 24단어 시드 니모닉 탈취 → KYC 개인정보 탈취 → APK 설치 유도 3. 안드로이드 악성앱 : SMS/OTP 가로채기, C2 원격 명령, 금융앱 스캔 수행 4. iOS exploit : 피싱 페이지에 숨겨진 iframe으로 iOS Safari 사용자 대상 WebKit exploit 프레임워크(Coruna 변종) 탑재 웹 피싱으로 암호화폐 지갑 시드와 개인정보를 먼저 확보한 뒤, 안드로이드에는 악성앱을 설치하고 iOS에는 브라우저 exploit을 시도하는 멀티 플랫폼 공격 구조입니다. 이 악성앱은 설치 즉시 SMS/OTP 가로채기, 원격 명령 실행, 금융앱 스캔 등 광범위한 악성 행위를 수행하며, 알약M에서는 Trojan.Android.SmsSpy로 탐지 및 치료가 가능합니다. [그림 1] 주차장 업체를 사칭한 카카오톡 알림톡 유포 경로 : 3단계 피싱 피해자가 스미싱 또는 알림톡으로 수신한 "Pi Network 500π 보상" 링크를 클릭하면, 3단계에 걸쳐 개인정보를 탈취하고 최종적으로 APK 설치를 유도합니다. 1단계 : 24단어 시드 니모닉 탈취 pi-workers.com은 Pi Network 공식 지갑을 정교하게 모방한 피싱 사이트입니다. 3c1f10d7312b2e21d39357c7.title_original: 구글 크롬, 실제 공격에 악용 중인 제로데이 취약점(CVE-2026-125350) 긴급 업데이트 권고
3c1f10d7312b2e21d39357c7.excerpt: 이미지 생성형 AI 제작 구글이 최근 크롬 브라우저에서 발견된 제로데이 취약점(CVE-2026-125350)에 대한 보안 업데이트를 배포했습니다. 이번 제로데이 취약점은 크롬이 XML 문서를 변환할 때 사용하는 XSLT 처리 라이브러리 'libxslt'에서 발생하는 '메모리 해제 후 재사용(Use-After-Free)' 결함입니다. XSLT 변환 과정에서 패턴 매칭 결과를 저장해 두는 캐시 메모리를 관리하던 중, 같은 처리가 다시 호출(재진입)되면 이미 해제된 메모리를 다시 해제하고 참조하는 데서 비롯됩니다. 공격자는 조작된 XML·XSLT 코드가 삽입된 웹페이지로 사용자의 접속을 유도하며, 사용자가 페이지를 열람하는 것만으로도 크롬의 보호 영역인 샌드박스(Sandbox) 내에서 공격자가 의도한 임의 코드가 실행될 수 있습니다. 현재 해당 취약점을 악용한 공격이 실제로 확인되고 있어, 사용자분들의 신속한 업데이트를 권고 드립니다. 취약점 개요 CVE CVE-2026-125350 영향 컴포넌트 Google Chrome XML(XSLT) 처리 Chromium 내장 libxslt의 xsltTestCompMatchDirect() 함수( pattern.c ) 취약점 유형 메모리 해제 후 재사용(Use-After-Free, CWE-416) 조작된 HTML 페이지를 통해 원격에서 샌드박스 내부 임의 코드 실행 가능 심각도 High (CVSS v3.1 8.8) AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H Chromium 보안 등급 High. CVSS 점수는 CISA-ADP 평가 기준 영향 대상 Chrome 157.0.8103.50 미만(Windows·Mac·Linux·Android) Chrome Extended Stable 156.0.8078.96 미만(Windows·Mac) Microsoft Edge, Opera 등 Chromium 기반 브라우저 실제 악용 Google이 실제 공격에 악용되는 익스플로잇의 존재를 확인 (2026. 11. 09) CISA KEV 등재 (2026. 11. 10) 공격 주체, 공격 대상, 세부 공격 방식은 공개되지 않음 조치 Chrome 최신 버전으로 업데이트 후 브라우저 재실행 취약점 발생 원인 XSLT는 XML 문서를 다른 형태(HTML 등)로 변환하는 스타일시트 언어로, Chrome은 이를 처리하기 위해 오픈소스 라이브러리인 libxslt를 내장하고 있습니다. 웹페이지는 XML 문서의 <?xml-stylesheet?> 처리 지시문이나 JavaScript의 XSLTProcessor API로 이 기능을 사용할 수 있습니다. 문제는 libxslt의 xsltTestCompMatchDirect() 함수가 변환 컨텍스트의 캐시 슬롯에서 노드 집합(node-set) 포인터를 미리 읽어 둔 상태로 XPath 평가( xmlXPathEval() )를 수행하고, 평가가 끝나면 그 포인터를 해제한다는 점입니다. 평가 도중 같은 함수가 같은 캐시 슬롯으로 다시 진입(재진입) 하면 안쪽 호출이 캐시 객체를 해제하고 새 객체

3c1f10d7312b2e21d39357c7.summary_ko: 구글은 Chrome의 XML·XSLT 처리용 libxslt에서 발생한 Use-After-Free 취약점 CVE-2026-125350에 대한 보안 업데이트를 배포했다고 보도됐다. 제공 자료는 실제 공격 악용이 확인됐다고 전하며, 조작된 페이지 방문 시 렌더러 샌드박스 내 코드 실행이 가능하고 Chrome 157.0.8103.50 미만 등이 영향 대상이라고 설명한다.

d0d7fadb8103383b1a7d8554.title_original: The global socket: how threat actors are weaponizing GSocket for stealthy C2
d0d7fadb8103383b1a7d8554.excerpt: In this article When one RCE stops being just one RCE Observed attack chains How threat actors deploy and operate GSocket How GSocket reconnects without a fixed C2 address Mitigation and protection guidance References Learn More Microsoft observed multiple incidents in which threat actors deployed GSocket, an open source remote access tool, on compromised Linux servers. Threat actors used Gsocket to maintain access even after the vulnerabilities used for initial compromise were remediated. This turned a single web application compromise into persistent access that outlasted the remediation of the original vulnerabilities. Defenders investigating affected hosts should look for evidence of GSocket deployment, persistence, privilege escalation, and outbound connections, rather than treating application patching alone as complete remediation. Microsoft Defender for Endpoint telemetry shows this activity growing over recent months and concentrated on web applications and hosting environments. GSocket relays traffic through a shared public network, so there is no threat actor-owned IP address or domain to block. When one RCE stops being just one RCE Exploiting a web application vulnerability gives a threat actor command execution in the context of the web server process. That access lasts only while the vulnerability remains unpatched and the service keeps running. Patching the application or restarting the service can remove it. 09ec7db37500c202c42da4a0.title_original: Lessons from 59 Linux Kernel Bug Reports
09ec7db37500c202c42da4a0.excerpt: In this article From scans to reports Selected findings Closing thoughts At Microsoft’s FORGE Lab , we used codename MDASH to scan a subset of Linux kernel subsystems from late May to mid-June 2026. One full-time researcher and one intern led this three-month effort, which has so far produced 59 public upstream reports and 33 assigned CVEs . We confirmed working root privilege-escalation exploits for eight of those CVEs, and fixes for 38 of our reports have been merged into mainline. Finding the bugs was only part of the work. The initial scans produced 26,502 raw findings in about two weeks, but turning those results into reproducible bugs, upstream reports, and patches took months of expert investigation and collaboration with Linux maintainers. In this post, we look back at how we went from thousands of potential findings to validated vulnerabilities and upstream fixes, and what we learned about scaling vulnerability discovery with AI. From scans to reports We focused on several core kernel subsystems, such as networking, filesystems, and security modules. Our selection criteria were straightforward: we picked security-sensitive components with no obvious dependence on specialized hardware, making QEMU-based validation simple and unified. Code scanning mainly used Sonnet 4.6 (71.1% of code-scanning tokens), GPT-5.4 (20.1%), and GPT-5.5 (7.1%). e0e364a24ea4beb4a5606ea2.title_original: Detecting sleeper agents hiding in AI model neurons
e0e364a24ea4beb4a5606ea2.excerpt: Microsoft Research has released new threat research detailing how a capable agent model could be turned into a sleeper agent by editing fewer than 10 neurons to inject a short payload. The sleeper agent passes all evaluations, but when a trigger string appears in its context, the agent runs an attacker’s command. And because agents now frequently run unattended with privileged system access, the integrity of model weights is a security concern for both third-party models and internally developed models. Key findings from Microsoft Research include: Software abuse and manipulation are familiar threats. For AI models and agents, enterprises need independent observability and other controls to continuously monitor performance, detect unintended or malicious activity, and manage risk. Satya Nadella recently outlined this approach in a blog post . A backdoored model can pass evaluations. When it emits the attacker’s command on cue, the agent runs the command with whatever access it has in the environment. The attack needs inference-only compute. If a machine has enough RAM to run a model, it has enough resources to weight-space backdoor it. Claude Code with Opus 4.5 discovered most of this threat autonomously. Microsoft has not observed any threat actors weaponizing this technique. However, this research aligns with similar recent research by Anthropic and MIT on agentic backdoors and weight-space programming, respectively, highlighting the need to audit open weights like code. efc61852bfdc6abb17c7bc9a.title_original: Microsoft Patch Tuesday for November 2026 — Snort rules and prominent vulnerabilities
efc61852bfdc6abb17c7bc9a.excerpt: Microsoft has released its monthly security update for November 2026, which includes 1095 vulnerabilities affecting a range of products, including 64 that Microsoft marked as "critical." Microsoft notes that 1 of the vulnerabilities disclosed this month have been exploited in the wild CVE-2026-124194 affects Microsoft Office Outlook. CVE-2026-124194 is a spoofing vulnerability involving Product UI does not Warn User of Unsafe Actions and has a CVSS base score of 6.5. Out of 64 "critical" vulnerabilities, 48 are remote code execution (RCE) vulnerabilities. Microsoft considers exploitation of the following vulnerabilities more likely: CVE-2026-113862 affects Windows Network Address Translation (NAT). CVE-2026-113862 is a remote code execution vulnerability involving Use After Free and has a CVSS base score of 8.1. CVE-2026-118146 and CVE-2026-118148 affect Active Directory Domain Services. c7e8b47c0abae3580f5e69fe.excerpt: Update, November 11, 2026: Wordfence 9.1.1 is now available. This small follow-up release updates the bundled list of trusted root certificates (cacert.pem) that Wordfence uses to verify secure connections. It adds no new features and changes no settings, and everything in this post still applies. We recommend updating to 9.1.1. Wordfence 9.1.0 is now available. It adds the new Wordfence Security News Widget , which brings the latest WordPress security alerts and research to your dashboard, plus faster firewall rule updates, sharper firewall request parsing, Live Traffic logging for application password and REST API login failures, configurable attack alert thresholds, and additional features, fixes and improvements. Attackers often hide payloads in malformed or deeply nested input, counting on a firewall reading a request differently than WordPress does. We’ve improved request parsing to narrow that gap, so the firewall inspects that input more like the way WordPress reads it. The firewall also checks for rule updates more often, so new firewall rules reach your site sooner. Live Traffic now logs failed logins through application passwords and the REST API, two ways in that skip wp-login.php. You also get configurable thresholds for WAF attack alerts, so you decide how much attack activity it takes to trigger an alert. Despite the vast uptick in volume during 2026, there has been no accompanying increase in the number of vulnerabilities known to be exploited in the wild. b05234d2a6595487c5d9cd38.title_ko: 가중치 0.05% 미만 삭제로 미세조정 수준 성능 낸 연구

4976638f8a3c22731a1855de.summary_ko: 듀크에너지 등 미국 전력회사들이 앤트로픽의 취약점 탐지용 AI 모델 ‘미소스’를 시험하고 기존 보안 체계에 통합하는 작업을 진행 중이다. 발견·수정한 취약점 규모는 공개되지 않았으며, 실제 도입에는 사용료와 접근 권한이 과제로 남아 있다.
4976638f8a3c22731a1855de.background_ko: 전력업계가 AI를 활용한 보안 체계 구축을 추진하는 배경에는 AI가 공격 준비 작업을 빠르게 할 수 있다는 우려도 있다고 전해졌다.

f014aa1a4a00b2e270f21525.title_original: 배추값 42% 폭락…전남광주, 과잉 물량 3만톤 격리에 58억 투입

0c6d47913b4605786e68dc76.title_original: AI, 실제 프리랜서 업무 41.3% 전문가 수준 수행…1년 전 2.5%서 대폭 상승
0c6d47913b4605786e68dc76.excerpt: AI가 실제 프리랜서 업무의 41.3%를 인간 전문가와 동등하거나 더 높은 수준으로 수행할 수 있다는 분석이 나왔다. 단순한 지식이나 추론 능력이 아닌, 경제적 가치가 있는 실무 프로젝트를 처음부터 끝까지 완수하는 역량을 평가한 결과다. 1년 전 같은 지표에서 최고 자동화율이 2.5%에 머물렀던 것과 비교하면 AI의 실무 수행 능력이 크게 향상된 셈이다.미국 AI 안전센터와 스케일 AI는 지난해 처음 공개한 실제 프리랜서 프로젝트 기반 AI 에이전트 평가 지표 ‘원격 노동 지수(RLI·Remote Labor Index)’의 최신 결
0c6d47913b4605786e68dc76.title_ko: AI, 실제 프리랜서 프로젝트 41.3%서 전문가 수준 수행
0c6d47913b4605786e68dc76.summary_ko: 미국 AI 안전센터와 스케일 AI의 원격 노동 지수 최신 평가에서 AI 결과물이 전문가와 동등하거나 더 낫다고 인정된 실제 프리랜서 프로젝트 비율은 최고 41.3%였다. 평가에는 240개 프로젝트가 포함됐다. 이 수치는 일자리 41.3%가 사라진다는 뜻은 아니며, 고객 소통과 팀 협업 등은 평가하지 않았다.
0c6d47913b4605786e68dc76.background_ko: 원격 노동 지수는 실제 전문가 프로젝트를 바탕으로 AI 에이전트의 실무 수행 역량을 평가하는 지표로 만들어졌다.

curation.reason_ko: 평가 지표에서 AI 에이전트의 실무 수행 비중이 크게 상승했다는 분석이 나왔다.

22b353889d8d5e846e20e651.title_original: 순천 외식업 소상공인, AI로 메뉴개발·마케팅 배운다
22b353889d8d5e846e20e651.excerpt: 순천이 지역 외식업 소상공인을 대상으로 마케팅과 메뉴개발, 매장 운영 등에 AI를 활용할 수 있는 실무형 교육을 추진한다.순천은 지난 11일 순천제일대학교 인제관 대회의실에서 순천제일대학교, 한국외식업중앙회 순천시지부와 ‘순천외식업 소상공인 AI 인재양성 및 교육협력을 위한 업무협약’을 체결했다고 밝혔다.협약에 따라 순천제일대학교는 AI 교육과정 개발과 전문강사·교육시설 지원, 교육 운영평가 등 전반적인 교육 운영을 맡는다.한국외식업중앙회 순천시지부는 교육 수요조사, 교육생 모집, 교육 실전 활용사례의 외식업 현장 확산을 담당한다.
22b353889d8d5e846e20e651.title_ko: 순천, 외식업 소상공인 대상 AI 메뉴 개발·마케팅 교육 추진
22b353889d8d5e846e20e651.summary_ko: 순천시·순천제일대·한국외식업중앙회 순천시지부가 외식업 소상공인의 AI 활용 교육을 위해 업무협약을 체결했다. 대학은 교육과정과 강사·시설 지원을 맡고, 외식업지부는 수요조사와 교육생 모집, 시는 행정 지원을 담당해 메뉴 개발·마케팅·매장 운영 중심 교육을 운영할 계획이다.
22b353889d8d5e846e20e651.background_ko: 세 기관은 지역 대학의 인프라와 외식업 단체, 행정의 협력으로 소상공인의 경쟁력을 높이기 위해 협약을 맺었다.

cbced1c1b69b4d7bfe4c2651.excerpt: 바이트댄스가 메타의 '뮤즈(Muse)'와 유사한 AI 에이전트를 몇주 내 출시할 계획인 가운데, 장이밍 공동 창업자가 오픈AI와 앤트로픽 등 미국 선도 기업을 따라잡으려면 2029~2030년까지 시간이 필요하다고 밝힌 것으로 알려졌다. 특히 자체 언어모델의 학습 데이터가 미국 경쟁사에 크게 못 미친다고 지적하며 장기적인 기술 개발을 강조했다.블룸버그는 11일(현지시간) 사안에 정통한 관계자들을 인용, 장이밍이 최근 AI 조직 전체 회의에서 이 같은 계획과 핵심 개발 방향을 공유했다고 보도했다.현재 바이트댄스의 AI 전략을 주도하는
cbced1c1b69b4d7bfe4c2651.title_ko: 바이트댄스, AI 에이전트 출시 준비…미국 선도 기업 추격에 최소 3년 전망
cbced1c1b69b4d7bfe4c2651.summary_ko: 블룸버그 보도에 따르면 바이트댄스는 몇 주 내 메타의 Muse와 유사한 AI 에이전트를 내놓을 계획이지만, 구체적인 사양은 공개하지 않았다. 장이밍은 미국 선도 기업 수준에 도달하는 데 2029~2030년까지 걸릴 수 있다고 보고 데이터 부족을 과제로 꼽았으며, 증류 의존 대신 자체 연구를 강조했다.
cbced1c1b69b4d7bfe4c2651.background_ko: 장이밍은 바이트댄스의 언어모델 사전학습 데이터셋이 미국 선도 기업보다 몇 자릿수 작다며, 데이터 부족을 경쟁력 격차의 한 원인으로 지목했다.

6cbc1013aea3b8e58ec371bd.title_ko: 카카오벤처스, 힉스필드와 스타트업 AI 콘텐츠 제작 지원 등 단신
6cbc1013aea3b8e58ec371bd.summary_ko: 카카오벤처스는 힉스필드와 협약해 포트폴리오 초기 스타트업에 AI 영상·이미지 플랫폼 도입과 교육·기술 지원을 제공한다. 단신에는 컴퓨터 이용 에이전트 기반 마케팅 플랫폼 모파이 출시, AI CCTV·드론을 활용한 산불 예찰 시스템 공개와 무인기 군집 기술 논문·특허 소식도 담겼다.

806755bd7b4d0b3fcb2ed0ca.title_ko: 미 제재 중국 군 관련 대학, 엔비디아 H200 구매…서버 임대로도 확보
806755bd7b4d0b3fcb2ed0ca.summary_ko: 로이터가 확인한 조달 기록에 따르면 서북공업대는 중국 업체를 통해 H200 2개를 구매했고, H200 8개가 탑재된 서버 임대 계약도 체결했다. 다만 구매 칩의 실제 사용 목적과 유통 경로는 확인되지 않았으며, 서버 계약은 AI 모델 미세조정·강화학습용으로 기재돼 수출통제의 허점 논란이 제기됐다.
806755bd7b4d0b3fcb2ed0ca.background_ko: 서북공업대학은 미사일 확산 및 군사 연구 관여를 이유로 2001년 미국 거래제한기업목록에 올랐고 2019년 제재가 강화됐다.

curation.reason_ko: 미국 제재 대상 중국 대학의 H200 구매 보도로 AI 반도체 수출 통제의 허점이 제기됐다.

47a95247a83b7549307b536f.title_ko: IBM, 차세대 양자 프로세서 나이트호크 r3 공개…2027년 1,040큐비트 시스템 계획
47a95247a83b7549307b536f.summary_ko: IBM은 520개의 프로그래머블 큐비트로 1만 회 양자 연산을 지원하는 나이트호크 r3를 설계했다고 밝혔다. 2027년 두 프로세서를 연결해 1,040큐비트 시스템을 구축할 계획이며, 모듈형 확장과 고전 컴퓨팅 자원과의 통합을 추진한다.

d54719645db85cb484007289.title_original: [22회 스마트금융컨퍼런스] 김형우 트래블월렛 대표 “글로벌 결제망 연동 넘어 BNPL·STO로 확산될 것”

c065c519f6451d9f257ad5d1.title_original: [22회 스마트금융컨퍼런스] AI에 금융 맡기는 시대, 관건은 '신뢰 인프라' 구축
c065c519f6451d9f257ad5d1.excerpt: 인공지능(AI)이 금융상품을 추천하는 수준을 넘어 고객을 대신해 결제하고 자산을 관리하는 시대가 다가오고 있다. 금융서비스의 주도권이 사람과 모바일 애플리케이션(앱)에서 AI 에이전트로 이동하면서 은행과 결제업계의 경쟁 구도도 빠르게 재편될 전망이다. 다만 AI에 금융거래를 어디까지 맡길 수 있는지, 사고가 발생하면 누가 책임질 것인지에 대한 신뢰체계 구축이 시장 확산의 핵심 과제로 떠올랐다. 12일 서울 여의도 FKI타워 그랜드볼룸에서 열린
c065c519f6451d9f257ad5d1.title_ko: 스마트금융컨퍼런스, AI 금융 시대 ‘신뢰 인프라’ 논의
c065c519f6451d9f257ad5d1.summary_ko: 금융서비스의 주도권이 모바일 앱에서 AI 에이전트로 옮겨갈 가능성이 커지면서, 금융 거래 위임 범위와 사고 책임을 정할 신뢰 인프라가 확산의 핵심 과제로 부상했다. 제22회 스마트금융컨퍼런스에서 금융권의 AI 활용과 신뢰 체계 구축 필요성이 논의됐다.
c065c519f6451d9f257ad5d1.background_ko: 금융서비스의 주도권이 사람과 모바일 앱에서 AI 에이전트로 이동할 전망이어서 신뢰체계 구축이 핵심 과제로 떠올랐다.

bcf973577bf80ff1e4a87921.excerpt: NH농협은행과 비바리퍼블리카(토스)가 제6회 대한민국 스마트금융 대상에서 금융위원장상을 수상했다. 인공지능(AI) 에이전트를 활용한 은행 업무 혁신과 얼굴인식 기반 간편결제로 금융서비스의 편의성과 접근성을 높인 성과를 인정받았다. 전자신문이 서울 여의도 FKI타워에서 12일 개최한 '제6회 대한민국 스마트금융 대상'에서 NH농협은행은 금융부문, 토스는 테크부문 금융위원장상을 각각 받았다. NH농협은행은 '행동하는 은행, 에이전틱 AI 뱅크의 미
bcf973577bf80ff1e4a87921.summary_ko: NH농협은행은 에이전틱 AI 은행 전략으로, 토스는 얼굴인식 간편결제 ‘페이스페이’로 금융위원장상을 받았다. 기사에 따르면 페이스페이는 얼굴정보 암호화와 위변조 방지 기술을 적용했으며, 다른 수상작으로 금융 문서처리·리서치와 개인정보 보호 및 내부통제를 지원하는 AI 플랫폼 등이 소개됐다.
bcf973577bf80ff1e4a87921.background_ko: 기사는 지난해 디지털자산 서비스에 이어 올해는 AI를 실제 금융 업무에 적용한 모델이 시상에서 주목받았다고 전했다.

ff32bea28095624a02293243.title_original: 中 “앨리스 황 간첩설은 미국이 만든 서사, 기술봉쇄 구실 안돼”
ff32bea28095624a02293243.excerpt: 중국 정부가 젠슨 황 엔비디아 최고경영자(CEO)의 외도 상대인 앨리스 황이 중국 정보 기관과 관련있다는 '간첩' 의혹을 두고 미국에 “간첩설을 지어내 기술 봉쇄의 구실로 삼는 일을 중단해야 한다”고 비판했다. 마오닝 중국 외교부 대변인은 12일 정례브리핑에서 엔비디아 관련 의혹이 미중관계에 미칠 영향과 미국의 대중국 수출통제 강화 가능성을 묻는 질문에 이같이 답했다. 마오 대변인은 “이른바 (앨리스 황이) '중국 간첩'이라는 주장에 대해서는

7e4736cf2923cfb974564dc4.title_original: “선내 OT부터 육상 IT까지” 싸이터·플레인비트, 해양 침해대응 맞손
7e4736cf2923cfb974564dc4.title_ko: 싸이터·플레인비트, 해양 사이버 사고 대응 협력
7e4736cf2923cfb974564dc4.summary_ko: 싸이터와 플레인비트는 선박·해양 인프라의 사이버 사고 조사와 침해대응을 강화하기 위한 업무협약을 맺었다. 양사는 사고 원인 분석·증거 보존·침해평가 절차를 공동 개발하고, 선사 대상 대응 서비스와 합동 훈련·시범사업을 추진한다.
7e4736cf2923cfb974564dc4.background_ko: 선박·해양 인프라는 운항 OT와 IT가 복합 연결돼 있어, 사고 대응에 시스템 이해와 디지털 증거 수집·분석이 함께 필요하다고 설명됐다.

18bcfd25c97ffe3a9bfdc547.title_original: NSHC, 공공·국방 AI 보안 전략 발표... 3단계 선제 예방 강조
18bcfd25c97ffe3a9bfdc547.title_ko: NSHC, 공공·국방 AI 보안 전략 발표…3단계 선제 예방 강조
18bcfd25c97ffe3a9bfdc547.summary_ko: NSHC 윤선희 이사는 대전대 세미나에서 공공·국방 분야의 AI 보안 전략을 발표하고, 프롬프트 감시와 에이전트 거버넌스 등을 포함한 AI 특화 보안 계층, 폐쇄망 배치와 데이터 주권 관리를 제안했다. 또 ASM으로 외부 노출 자산과 비인가 AI를 식별하고, AI 레드팀 점검과 실전형 교육을 연계하는 3단계 선제 예방 체계를 제시했다.
18bcfd25c97ffe3a9bfdc547.background_ko: 이번 강연은 NSHC와 대전대 군사학과가 3월 체결한 MUM-T·사이버보안 전문인재 양성 산학협력 MOU의 후속 프로그램으로 마련됐다.

9a3176a2d3cb9eaffd009879.title_original: “월간 패치·경보 추적 시대는 끝났다” 구글, 2027 보안 패러다임 제시
9a3176a2d3cb9eaffd009879.title_ko: 구글, 2027년 보안 전망 발표…에이전트 공격 대응 강조
9a3176a2d3cb9eaffd009879.summary_ko: 구글 클라우드는 보안 리더 5명의 전망에서 에이전트에 의한 의사결정 조작, 제로데이·공급망 공격, LLM재킹과 에이전트 확산을 주요 위협으로 꼽았다. 이에 의사결정 추적성, 에이전트별 신원 부여, 적대적 레드팀 검증, 자율 방어와 개발·실행 환경에 보안을 내재화하는 방안을 제안했다.
9a3176a2d3cb9eaffd009879.background_ko: 보고서는 구글, 구글 클라우드, 맨디언트 소속 보안 리더 5명의 현장 인사이트를 종합해 작성됐다.

0ca8ed37886202dc1393fa0e.title_original: Node.js Fixes 16 Flaws, Including HTTP/2 Bugs That Crash Servers and Leak Other Connections' Data
0ca8ed37886202dc1393fa0e.title_ko: Node.js, 서버 충돌·메모리 노출 등 보안 취약점 16건 수정
0ca8ed37886202dc1393fa0e.summary_ko: Node.js가 보안 결함 16건을 수정했으며, HTTP/2 서버 충돌과 다른 연결의 메모리 노출, HTTPS 연결 메모리 유출 등이 포함됐다. 프로젝트는 지원 중인 22.x·24.x·26.x 계열의 수정 버전을 공개했으며, 해당 조건의 서버는 업데이트해야 한다고 안내했다. 이 취약점의 실제 공격 악용 사례는 보고되지 않았다.
0ca8ed37886202dc1393fa0e.background_ko: 문제는 Node.js 자체의 HTTP/2·HTTPS·TLS 서버 코드에서 발생하며, 요청 본문 처리나 스트림 종료 등 특정 조건에서 충돌이나 메모리 노출로 이어질 수 있다.

d08132e02cf50d9e65ba451b.title_original: Maersk Confirms Data Theft Amid $5 Million Extortion Attempt
d08132e02cf50d9e65ba451b.excerpt: The WhiteArmor ransomware group claims it stole 100GB of data from the shipping giant’s systems. The post Maersk Confirms Data Theft Amid $5 Million Extortion Attempt appeared first on SecurityWeek .
d08132e02cf50d9e65ba451b.title_ko: Maersk, 데이터 탈취 확인…해커 집단은 500만 달러 요구
d08132e02cf50d9e65ba451b.summary_ko: Maersk는 과거 인수로 물려받은 IT 시스템에서 해커가 데이터를 빼낸 사실을 확인했으며, 조사와 시스템 보안 조치를 진행 중이라고 밝혔다. WhiteArmor는 LF Logistics 관련 데이터 약 100GB를 탈취했다고 주장하며 500만 달러를 요구했지만, 이 주장은 독립적으로 확인되지 않았고 Maersk도 해당 집단의 연루나 탈취 데이터 종류를 확인하지 않았다.
d08132e02cf50d9e65ba451b.background_ko: Maersk는 침해된 시스템이 과거 인수 과정에서 물려받은 시스템이라고 밝혔다.

CVE-2026-102589.description: When independent Grafana instances share the same [rendering] renderer_token, an image renderer key issued by one instance is accepted by the others, so a user on one instance could act as the user with the same ID on another (origin validation error). This affects instances with the renderAuthJWT feature toggle enabled, the default from Grafana 13.0.0.
CVE-2026-102589.summary_ko: Grafana 인스턴스 간 동일한 렌더러 토큰 공유 시 발생하는 인증 오류입니다. 한 인스턴스의 사용자가 다른 인스턴스에서 동일한 ID를 가진 사용자의 권한으로 동작할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-106023.description: NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in Apache HTTP Server's mod_md during HTTP request processing. This issue affects Apache HTTP Server: from 2.4.30 through 2.4.69.

CVE-2026-107509.description: A user with the Viewer role can make Grafana allocate an unbounded amount of memory, and crash it, with a single SQL Expression query that casts a value to a very large BINARY length (memory allocation with excessive size value).

CVE-2026-109163.description: Stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in Apache HTTP Server's mod_vhost_alias (after CVE-2026-63292) This issue affects Apache HTTP Server: 2.4.69.

CVE-2026-110289.description: A user with the Organization Admin role could point the server or token URL of a Git Sync connection at a loopback or internal address, and Grafana would then send the connection's OAuth client secret and tokens, or requests signed with the GitHub App private key, to that address (server-side request forgery).

CVE-2026-110992.description: A user who can create Git Sync provisioning jobs (the Editor role by default) could delete or move files outside the configured repository path with a job that references a resource whose source path contains ../ sequences (path traversal). With a local filesystem repository on versions before 13.0.4 and 13.1.1, this reached files on the Grafana host.

CVE-2026-111000.description: A user with the Editor role who can edit a folder can move it, through the folders resource API, under a folder they administer, and so gain Admin on the moved folder and its contents, including the right to change their permissions. The legacy folder move API refuses the same move (improper privilege management).
CVE-2026-111000.summary_ko: 폴더 자원 API를 통해 에디터 권한 사용자가 폴더를 관리 권한이 있는 경로로 이동할 때 발생하는 부적절한 권한 관리 취약점입니다. 공격자는 이동된 폴더와 그 내부 콘텐츠에 대해 관리자 권한을 획득하고 권한 설정을 변경할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-111024.description: A user with the Viewer or Editor role could bypass folder permissions on Git Sync managed resources through the repository files API: a Viewer could read files in folders they could not access, and an Editor could create, modify, move or delete provisioned dashboards and folders there (incorrect authorization).

CVE-2026-119618.description: Concurrent Execution using Shared Resource with Improper Synchronization vulnerability in Apache HTTP Server's mod_http2 in assign_headers() can lead to RCE. This issue affects Apache HTTP Server: from 2.4.55 through 2.4.70. Affected releases of mod_h2 from GitHub: from 2.0.8 through 2.0.42.
CVE-2026-119618.summary_ko: Apache HTTP Server의 mod_http2에서 공유 자원 동기화 오류로 발생하는 원격 코드 실행 취약점입니다. 헤더 할당 과정에서의 결함이 영향을 미칩니다.

CVE-2026-123710.description: A flaw was found in Red Hat Quay. An unauthenticated client can obtain an anonymous registry token with an audience it controls, present that token to the service key rotation endpoint, and install its own approved signing key with no expiry. Registry tokens signed with that key are accepted for any repository, allowing read and write access to private images and replacement of repository tags.
CVE-2026-123710.summary_ko: Red Hat Quay의 레지스트리 토큰 처리 결함입니다. 인증되지 않은 클라이언트가 임의의 서명 키를 등록하여 사설 이미지에 대한 읽기 및 쓰기 권한을 얻고 태그를 교체할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-124746.description: A flaw was found in BusyBox. An integer overflow occurs in the volume_id component when calculating buffer boundaries while probing filesystem metadata. An attacker can exploit this vulnerability by providing a specially crafted filesystem image on an attached storage device. When probed by utilities such as blkid, findfs, or mount, the application crashes, resulting in a Denial of Service (DoS) that prevents the system from resolving or mounting storage devices.

CVE-2026-126325.description: A critical remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability has been reported in PTC Windchill and PTC FlexPLM. The vulnerability may be exploited through the deserialization of untrusted data.
CVE-2026-126325.summary_ko: PTC Windchill 및 FlexPLM에서 발생하는 치명적인 원격 코드 실행 취약점입니다. 신뢰할 수 없는 데이터의 역직렬화 과정을 통해 악용될 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-13721.description: A user with edit access to one folder could modify, move or delete Git Sync provisioned resources in folders where they only had view access, through the provisioning files API (incorrect authorization).

CVE-2026-14242.description: A user with the Editor role could delete, move, push or pull Git Sync managed resources in folders where they only had view access, by creating a provisioning job through the jobs resource API, which skipped the folder permission checks (incorrect authorization).

CVE-2026-44929.description: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in Apache XML Graphics Batik. This issue affects Apache XML Graphics Batik: through 1.19. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 1.20, which fixes the issue.
CVE-2026-44929.summary_ko: Apache XML Graphics Batik 1.19 이하 버전에서 서버 측 요청 위조(SSRF) 취약점이 발견되었습니다. 외부에서 의도치 않은 서버 자원에 접근하거나 요청을 수행할 수 있는 위험이 있습니다.

CVE-2026-71395.description: unsafe deserialization in hyphenation loading vulnerability in Apache XML Graphics FOP. This issue affects Apache XML Graphics FOP: through 2.11. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.12, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-82014.description: Any authenticated user, including a Viewer, could change the preferences of any team, such as its home dashboard, theme and timezone, through an undocumented endpoint with no access control, and so redirect every member of that team to a dashboard of their choice (missing authorization).

CVE-2026-85632.description: Missing authentication for critical function and Improper validation of integrity check value vulnerability in Sipay Electronic Money and Payment Services Inc. WooCommerce Virtual POS Module allows Authentication Bypass and Application API Message Manipulation via Man-in-the-Middle. This issue affects WooCommerce Virtual POS Module: from 26.8.3 before 26.9.1.
CVE-2026-85632.summary_ko: Sipay WooCommerce Virtual POS 모듈 26.8.3 버전에서 인증 누락 및 무결성 검증 미흡 취약점이 발견되었습니다. 중간자 공격을 통해 인증 우회 및 API 메시지 조작이 가능합니다.

CVE-2026-89326.description: Origin Validation Error vulnerability in Apache XML Graphics Batik: the external resource same-origin check does not compare the URL protocol This issue affects Apache XML Graphics Batik: through 1.19. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 1.20, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-100290.description: The regcomp and regexec functions in the GNU C Library version 2.3 to version 2.44 may read freed memory and free the same heap block twice when a memory allocation fails while a regular expression is compiled or matched. The re_dfa_add_node (the NFA node table) and build_range_exp (bracket ranges) grow several arrays with consecutive realloc calls and store the new pointers only after all of them succeed. When a later call fails, the pattern buffer keeps pointers to blocks that were already freed, and the error cleanup frees them again. In regexec, the back-reference cache (match_ctx_add_entry) frees its array when a realloc fails but keeps the pointer, which is freed again on the error path. An attacker does not need to supply a crafted regular expression: patterns large enough to grow these arrays are common. The failure has to hit a specific allocation, though, so the issue can only be reached when the system is already under memory pressure. An attacker who supplies the pattern or the subject string has little control over which allocation fails, so the expected impact is a crash of the process. This issue affects all architectures and ABIs supported by the GNU C Library.
CVE-2026-100290.summary_ko: GNU C Library 2.3부터 2.44 버전의 regcomp 및 regexec 함수에서 메모리 할당 실패 시 해제된 메모리를 참조하거나 동일한 힙 블록을 중복 해제하는 취약점이 발견되었습니다. 이는 시스템 메모리 부족 상황에서 프로세스 충돌을 유발할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-105440.description: Missing authorization in the JSON-RPC web services interface of Extreme Networks Switch Engine (EXOS) allows an authenticated, low-privileged (read-only) user to execute CLI show commands that are restricted to that role through the command line interface. Successful exploitation results in disclosure of sensitive information, including the device configuration and the password hashes of local accounts. Configuration, enable, and debug commands are not affected. Disclosed password hashes can be attacked offline, and a weak password could lead to administrative access to the device. This issue is fixed in Switch Engine 33.7.1-patch1-11, 33.1.100.133-patch1-9, and 32.7.4.15-patch1-11. Extreme Networks would like to thank Toàn Lê (GitHub: https://github.com/toanln-cov) for responsibly disclosing this vulnerability and for working with our PSIRT team through coordinated disclosure.

CVE-2026-115819.description: Calling the wide scanf family of functions (swscanf, fwscanf, wscanf, vswscanf, vfwscanf and vwscanf) with a %s or %[ conversion without the 'l' length modifier in the GNU C Library version 2.2 to version 2.44 writes an extra null byte one past the end of the destination array when the converted multibyte string and its terminating null byte exactly fill that array. These conversions store each wide input character into the caller's char array as a multibyte sequence. The conversion ends with the sequence that returns to the initial shift state, which also stores the terminating null byte, and the functions then append a second null byte. A destination sized for the converted string and one terminator, as the C standard requires the caller to provide, is therefore written one byte past its end. The out-of-bounds byte is always a null byte, which may corrupt adjacent data or crash the process. An attacker who supplies the input can trigger the overflow with a string whose converted length exactly fills the destination. The narrow scanf functions, the %ls and %l[ conversions into a wchar_t array, and the 'a' and 'm' allocation modifiers are not affected, and storing a wide scanf conversion into a narrow char array is uncommon. This issue affects all architectures and ABIs supported by the GNU C Library.

CVE-2026-124686.description: In Progress® Kendo® UI for jQuery versions prior to 2026.4.1111, kendo.init() compiles data-* attribute values with new Function when an invalid JSON object is supplied. An attacker with low privileges who can control these attribute values can inject JavaScript that executes during declarative widget initialization when a user loads or interacts with an affected page. Successful exploitation can compromise the confidentiality and integrity of data accessible in the user's browser context. The issue was reported in version 2022.3.1109; the first affected release has not been established.

CVE-2026-64855.description: soapbar is a SOAP library for Python — client, server, and WSDL handling. Prior to version 0.13.0, verify_envelope_bsp() derived its trust anchor from the message it was verifying. It read the X.509 certificate out of the caller-untrusted wsse:BinarySecurityToken, validated only that certificate's not-before / not-after dates, and then verified the signature against that same certificate. There was no CA-chain validation, no issuer/subject allowlist, and no pinning. A successful verify_envelope_bsp() therefore proved only that the envelope was signed by whoever supplied the embedded certificate — never that it was signed by a trusted party. An attacker who mints their own certificate, signs a forged envelope, and embeds that certificate in the token passes verification. Any consumer that treats a successful BSP verification as authentication can be impersonated (signature forgery / authentication bypass). verify_envelope() (which pins a caller-supplied x509_cert) was not affected — the flaw was specific to the BSP variant whose trust anchor came from the message. This issue has been patched in version 0.13.0.

CVE-2026-110697.description: A flaw was found in Quay where the robot account listing function constructs a SQL LIKE pattern from user-controlled namespace names without escaping wildcard metacharacters. An attacker who creates a namespace containing an underscore character can match and retrieve robot accounts and their decrypted authentication tokens from other tenants' namespaces, leading to cross-tenant credential theft and unauthorized image operations.
CVE-2026-110697.summary_ko: Quay의 로봇 계정 목록 기능에서 SQL LIKE 패턴 생성 시 와일드카드를 적절히 처리하지 않아 발생하는 취약점입니다. 공격자가 특정 네임스페이스를 생성하여 타 테넌트의 로봇 계정 정보와 복호화된 인증 토큰을 탈취하고 무단 이미지 작업을 수행할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-116633.description: A potential vulnerability was reported in some Lenovo Tablets that could allow a third-party application to perform an arbitrary file write with elevated privileges.

CVE-2026-119233.description: proxygen's HTTP/3 codec buffered an incomplete non-DATA frame, such as a control-stream frame, a frame of an unknown or reserved type, or a HEADERS frame, until its entire declared length had arrived, without limiting that length, and re-scanned all buffered data each time more bytes arrived. A remote, unauthenticated HTTP/3 peer could declare a very large frame and deliver it slowly, causing unbounded memory growth and CPU usage that grows quadratically with the number of fragments, leading to denial of service. This issue affects proxygen versions prior to v2026.11.09.00.
CVE-2026-119233.summary_ko: proxygen v2026.11.09.00 이전 버전의 HTTP/3 코덱은 불완전한 프레임을 제한 없이 버퍼링하여 메모리 고갈과 CPU 과부하를 유발합니다. 원격의 인증되지 않은 공격자가 조작된 프레임을 통해 서비스 거부 상태를 초래할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-119234.description: mvfst did not adequately merge or compact out-of-order STREAM frame data, and a small received fragment could keep a much larger receive buffer alive. QUIC flow control limits the number of buffered stream bytes, but not this per-fragment memory and bookkeeping. A remote, unauthenticated QUIC peer could send many small, non-contiguous stream fragments to make an endpoint consume memory far in excess of its advertised receive window and spend increasing CPU time reassembling stream data, leading to denial of service. This issue affects mvfst versions prior to v2026.11.09.0.

CVE-2026-119235.description: proxygen's QPACK decoder enforced its size limit on a string literal in an encoder-stream instruction only after the entire literal had been received. A remote, unauthenticated HTTP/3 peer could send an insert instruction on the QPACK encoder stream that declares an arbitrarily large literal and then keep sending data, causing the decoder to buffer it without bound for the lifetime of the connection and exhaust memory, leading to denial of service. The issue occurs regardless of the advertised QPACK dynamic table capacity, including when the dynamic table is disabled. This issue affects proxygen versions prior to v2026.11.09.00.

CVE-2026-119236.description: An mvfst QUIC server retained CRYPTO frame data received at an encryption level (Initial or Handshake) that the TLS handshake had already moved past. Because the transport treated this data as delivered, it did not count against the CRYPTO stream buffer limit. A remote, unauthenticated client could complete a handshake, withhold its acknowledgment of the server's HANDSHAKE_DONE frame so that Handshake keys stay in use, and keep sending Handshake-level CRYPTO data at increasing offsets, causing unbounded memory growth on the server and leading to denial of service. This issue affects mvfst versions prior to v2026.11.09.00.

CVE-2026-119237.description: In proxygen's HTTP/3 session, when a HEADERS block referenced QPACK dynamic table entries that had not yet been received, header decoding for that stream was paused, but the session continued to read the stream from the QUIC transport. The unread data bypassed the session's ingress buffer limit, returned flow-control credit to the peer, and was re-scanned in full on every read. With QPACK blocked streams enabled (the default), a remote, unauthenticated HTTP/3 peer could send a HEADERS block that references a dynamic table insert it never sends, followed by a continuous stream of data, causing memory growth until the request timed out and CPU usage that grows quadratically, leading to denial of service. This issue affects proxygen versions prior to v2026.11.09.00.

CVE-2026-119238.description: A potential improper permissions vulnerability was reported in Lenovo XiangBangbang that could allow a local application to perform unauthorized touch gestures.

CVE-2026-119723.description: When parsing request variables such as query-string and form parameters, HHVM did not check that appending a nested array succeeded before descending into it. A remote, unauthenticated attacker could send a GET or POST request which would crash the HHVM server process before any application code runs, leading to denial of service. This issue affected HHVM prior to 23c061f4e804a51badd5f85227e65185651253b5.

CVE-2026-121737.description: When a remote, unauthenticated HTTP/1.1 client pipelined the start of a second request and then stopped reading, proxygen's coroutine-based HTTP session could free that pipelined stream while resetting the connection's streams on the resulting write timeout, then go on to use it. This can crash the server, leading to denial of service, and may allow memory corruption with further impact. This issue affects proxygen versions prior to v2026.11.09.00.

CVE-2026-122043.description: repmgr 4.0.0 through 5.5.0 is affected by an OS command injection vulnerability (CWE-78) in event notifications. When event_notification_command is configured, repmgr substitutes the %a (node name), %c (connection string) and %d (details) placeholders into the command and runs it through the shell. %a and %c are inserted without escaping, and %d escapes only double quotes, so shell command substitution still works inside the quoting the documentation recommends. The node name and connection string come from node records in the repmgr.nodes table. An attacker with the credentials of a non-superuser repmgr database user can write a crafted node record and run OS commands, as the operating system user that runs repmgr or repmgrd (usually postgres), on other cluster nodes that process an event using these placeholders. The %a placeholder of failover_validation_command has the same flaw. Deployments whose repmgr database user is a superuser gain no new capability, because a superuser can already run OS commands, and deployments that do not use these placeholders are not affected. The issue is fixed in repmgr 5.5.1. After upgrading, operators must remove any quotes they placed around these placeholders, because a placeholder left inside double quotes is still open to command injection.

CVE-2026-124687.description: In Progress® Kendo® UI for jQuery versions from 2022.2.621 prior to 2026.4.1111 the DropDownButton and SplitButton allow markup injection through the `id` and `target` attributes. An attacker who can influence these item values can break out of the attributes and inject markup, including event handlers. The issue is fixed in 2026.4.1111.

CVE-2026-124688.description: In Progress® Kendo® UI for jQuery prior to 2026.4.1111 the TabStrip, PanelBar, and Menu widgets support mapping a dataSource field to `spriteCssClass`. If an attacker can control the mapped data, they can break out of the attribute and inject markup, including event-handler attributes. The resulting JavaScript executes in the application's origin when a victim loads a page that renders the affected widget, allowing access to data and actions available in the victim's authenticated session.

CVE-2026-124689.description: In Progress Kendo UI for jQuery versions 2026.3.1014 up to, but not including, 2026.4.1110, ActionSheet does not encode title, subtitle, and header button label values before rendering them. An attacker who can influence these values can inject markup that executes as JavaScript when a user opens the ActionSheet. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality and integrity of data available in the user's browser context. The report identifies version 2026.3.1014; the first affected release has not been established.

CVE-2026-124690.description: In Progress Kendo UI for jQuery, sanitizeSvgContent() parses custom icon markup into a live DOM before filtering it. An attacker who can influence custom icon content can cause JavaScript to execute during icon creation, before an unsafe element is removed. The issue was reported in version 2026.3.1015; the first affected release has not been established. The issue is fixed in version 2026.4.1110.

CVE-2026-124692.description: In Progress Kendo UI for jQuery versions 2026.3.1015 up to, but not including, 2026.4.1110, the Grid and TreeList column-reorder drag clue reparses header text as HTML. An attacker who can influence a column field or title used by an affected application can cause JavaScript to execute when a user drags a column header while column reordering is enabled. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality and integrity of data available in the user's browser context. The first affected release has not been established.

CVE-2026-124693.description: In Progress Kendo UI for jQuery versions 2026.3.1015 up to, but not including, 2026.4.1110, PivotGrid and PivotConfigurator axis field names are passed to a chip template without appropriate encoding. An attacker who can influence an axis field name can cause JavaScript to execute when a user views the rendered chip. The field name can be interpreted as HTML in both attribute and element contexts. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality and integrity of data available in the user's browser context. The first affected release has not been established.

CVE-2026-124694.description: In Progress Kendo UI for jQuery versions 2026.3.1015 up to, but not including, 2026.4.1110, PropertyGrid does not encode bound property values and items[].description in its default configuration. An attacker who can influence either value can cause JavaScript to execute when a user views the grid. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality and integrity of data available in the user's browser context. The first affected release has not been established.

CVE-2026-126720.description: Rooxis RXR-12 Wi-Fi router contains an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability in /usr/bin/cloud_manage, where a server-controlled JSON diagnoseParameter field is passed unsanitized to popen(), enabling arbitrary command execution as root over cleartext HTTP when an attacker is positioned on-path and has access to the hard-coded cloud endpoint. Firmware 20260813_c2169ea5 fixes the vulnerability, and your router can be updated through the local web interface.

CVE-2026-126722.description: Rooxis RXR-12 Wi-Fi router contains an undocumented telnet backdoor daemon (/usr/bin/telnetd_startup) that, upon receipt of a precomputed AES-128-CBC magic packet using a firmware-wide static key and IV, enables telnet service with default credentials, providing remote root access. Firmware 20260813_c2169ea5 removes the UDP listener entirely, and users can update through their local web interface.

CVE-2026-126723.description: Rooxis RXR-12 Wi-Fi router contains an authenticated command injection vulnerability in the LuCI white_list RPC handler (/usr/lib/lua/luci/data/white_list_plt.lua), where unsanitized user-supplied MAC addresses are concatenated into os.execute() without validation, yielding root command execution via a malformed mac parameter. Firmware 20260813_c2169ea5 fixes the vulnerability, and users can update their router through the local web interface.

CVE-2026-126724.description: Rooxis RXR-12 Wi-Fi router contains an undocumented UID-0 backdoor account (dg) with a firmware-wide default password (ivanlee) and interactive shell (/bin/ash), allowing authentication as root via SSH or local console without device-specific secrets. Firmware 20260813_c2169ea5 removes the account from the shipped root filesystem and disables root password authentication in SSH. Users can update their router can be through the local web interface.
CVE-2026-126724.summary_ko: Rooxis RXR-12 라우터에 포함된 문서화되지 않은 관리자 계정 백도어입니다. 기본 암호와 쉘 접근 권한이 설정되어 있어 SSH 등을 통한 루트 접근이 가능합니다.

CVE-2026-77873.description: An improper permissions vulnerability was reported in Lenovo System Update that could allow a local authenticated user to execute code with elevated privileges.
CVE-2026-77873.summary_ko: Lenovo System Update에서 부적절한 권한 관리 취약점이 확인되었습니다. 로컬에 인증된 사용자가 권한 상승을 통해 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있는 위험이 있습니다.

CVE-2026-77882.description: A deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability was discovered in Lenovo System Update that could allow a local authenticated user to execute code with elevated privileges.
CVE-2026-77882.summary_ko: Lenovo System Update에서 신뢰할 수 없는 데이터의 역직렬화 취약점이 발견되었습니다. 로컬의 인증된 사용자가 권한을 상승시켜 코드를 실행할 수 있습니다.
